title: Briefing for 2026-11-24
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-24: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Peterson: Here’s what Bessent’s about-face on Jensen Huang reveals about Trump and China. Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy. Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices. Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%. St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months. Peterson: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means.
global: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang. US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal. Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports. What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war. Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book. Nvidia value climbs by almost $1tn and tech stocks rally after Jensen Huang returns.
philippines: Marcos appoints Lacanilao as DOTr usec, Noreen San Luis as LTO chief. BARMM has a new parliament, but the guns remain. [Vantage Point] Boardroom gymnastics, retail stakes: Unpacking the Rockwell deal. Order in the Court: Supreme Court’s good news for seafarers.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
